episode-1_07072026.txt.tldr: Balance talk, modules, Marder and ALVT nerf incoming, QoL, leader boards, CC programme requirements revealed, other smaller stuff.

questions.question: Will there be another rebalancing of long-range shots, currently too high perhaps bringing them down from 75 to 40? It's a bit worrying as the next tanks are Leos.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: So, balancing is going to be a constant thing, right? It's not going to be a one-off, but we have a big amount of balancing changes coming in with S1. My main worry was that it's really hard to fit this many into a change log. We will absolutely see what can be done about other things, right? But if a balance change isn't in this season - doesn't mean it's not going to be in the next one for example.

questions.question: It would be nice if the top-players get an extra tech-bonus to encourage people doing the objectives. I always suffer from having a bad team with having 2x-3x points more than the other players in the team.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: I think that's a good piece of feedback and I think that's something we definitely need to look at , like reward economy and making sure that the right actions are rewarded in the right way.

questions.question: Any chance we could see a BTR in HEAT?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Generally, if there is a tank, and it fits roughly in our time period there is always a good chance that you'll see it. But I can't, even if I know, and sometimes I do know; I can't confirm or deny whether a specific tank will be coming to the game soon, cuz that would kinda be giving it away a little bit.

questions.question: I wonder where are the WoT HEAT servers [located]... my average ping in any game is 49-60. Only HEAT is higher. Are they located in the UK?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: I believe our EU servers are mainly in Luxembourg. I also think this is the same place that WoT servers are. Because unsurprisingly we use the same infrastructure provider.

questions.question: I am having a better ping from Frankfurt but not from Luxembourg.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: It may also be Frankfurt, to be honest - I'm not sure. I'm a community guy, not an infrastructure expert. But if you think there is an issue, and you are having unexpectedly bad connection, then please do reach out to our support team, and we'll go and have a look and see if we can confirm it's on our side AND if there is anything we can do.

questions.question: Can we receive soon more modules for more customization and gameplay focus of our tanks?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Yes. This is something that we will definitely be adding. I'm not sure if new modules will be coming with Season 1, but I know that we have a massive module balance change coming, and we're touching a lot of them. But, new ones for sure will be coming down the line.

answers.speaker: Similar question was asked on another stream later and Remmy gave this answer
answers.text: A: (Remmy) Not for this season. But perhaps for future seasons.

questions.question: What will be firstly added: API (stats) or tournaments?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Probably tournaments.

answers.speaker: Mr.Matcha
answers.text: We would like to run them, we are thinking about some, but it's too early to say anything. But yes, we want to give you guys some nice competition because you really crave it.

questions.question: Do you plan on doing guides at some stage, explaining some of the more complex mechanics?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Well actually we've already been doing that. You can find a lot of them either on our Steam or WGC or both. If you have specific mechanics that you want to see explained, you can always reach out to us, and we will do it.

questions.question: When is Ray coming back to the game?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Eventually

questions.question: Do you think it would be possible to get a range indicator to help with aiming HE like that?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Yes. I do believe it is possible and I believe we're already planning on adding that

questions.question: Do you guys play other WG games or only HEAT?

answers.speaker: Mr.Matcha
answers.text: Yes, we do. Of course we like to see what's up with the main WoT game, we are checking out what's going on with WoWs. These are our main games that we are checking out, at least I check out; quite regularly. Like, 1-2 games now and then, just to see what changed, what's new.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: You can actually find me in WoT, I'm under the same name - 121Remmy or under ShoulderPain(?) later confirmed to be a retired nickname, which is my alt name. But yeah, I play a lot of tanks, I play a lot of Ashigaru, and I'm kinda getting back into Italian tanks, very slowly.

questions.question: Buff Marder.

answers.speaker: Mr.Matcha & Remmy
answers.text: No I don't think so

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: The vehicle itself is generally fine, it's just the mines that need to be addressed a little bit. And they will be.

questions.question: What are the plans for addressing ALVT over-performance?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Good point. Actually I was discussing this with one of our designers recently, and they also agree that damage output and reload right now is just too much, so damage is likely to stay the same, I want to say, reload might drop a little bit. So, very likely that it will get nerfed. At least a little bit.

questions.question: And what about Raketa?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Off the top of my head I don't think anything is planned for Raketa's ultimate. Maybe a tad bit later down the line. But for now, probably no?

questions.question: Zealous is probably get replaced with Retribution (for ALVT)

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Good point. I think it will as well. Or either replaced or completely removed.

questions.question: Is canister [shell] under-performing statistically?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: The trick with canister [shell] is that it's very difficult to make good use of it. So if you have someone who really practices - it can be actually quite strong. But generally kinda under-performing a little bit.

questions.question: We need leader boards for us guys that love competitive gameplay.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It will come.

questions.question: Any info about the CC programme?

answers.speaker: Mr.Matcha
answers.text: So, we already sent out invitation links to people who got accepted into the programme. We sent out emails to people who unfortunately did not qualify. But don't worry, it's not a final list, we keep checking for new content creators all the time, so if you qualify you can expect an email from us. I don't have a timeline yet, we are just about to kick off S1, so sometime after S1 deploys, we'll be checking the new applications, so don't worry, a little bit of patience and your time may come. And also, if you got rejected at this time, it doesn't mean you cannot reapply in the future.

questions.question: Can we be told, what are the qualifying requirements for the CC programme?

answers.speaker: Mr.Matcha
answers.text: So, we are not necessarily looking at numbers, because we understand we’re also a brand-new game, we cannot expect you guys to have a huge follow-up straight away. We're looking at your other qualities of your content that you're producing, engagement, quality, how well it is produced. The type of content also that you produce, maybe you're happy to make some guides for how to operate a specific tank right? We're all looking for this kind of content.

questions.question: Do you feel like any tanks are more under tuned?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: There are absolutely tanks that are too strong and some that need some buffing. There's going to be a whole stuff of balance tweaks coming with the S1 update, mainly to equipment, but we're going to be following it up with tank stat changes in all kinds of things as well going forward.

questions.question: Why isn't the game [Concurrent] online very big and will you do anything about it?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Absolutely. So of course we're going to be improving the game, which always helps; we'll also going to be doing more marketing, as you can see we are right now at Tankfest, telling people about the game and hopefully when they get hope they'll play some more tanks, and they will join us on the battlefield. But otherwise, feel free to invite your friends, bring someone. But at the moment we are just starting out. So, don't worry.

questions.question: How is the game SO unbalanced after so many years of testing? Were you guys rushed to release the game?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text:
So, first of all, I have an issue with your assumption that the game is SO unbalanced. There are definitely improvements to be made, but overall I think the game is actually in a pretty decent state right now and the improvements will be made, so there will be things that you'll feel, don't worry. But the main problem is that it's impossible to balance an online video game without being fully online and without players being in your game. It's necessary. 

People have different ways of playing, different ways of interacting with the game, and you can't get the data to really refine balancing until you get a huge amount of people playing over time, because over time people get progression, they learn, they get better, they figure out what works, what doesn't work, and then you can start making some fantastic conclusions about what is balanced, what isn't, and what needs to be tweaked.

questions.question: Do you have any plan on putting Obj.279 back into the game?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Yes. So, we have obviously tested quite a few other tanks in alpha, and you can expect pretty much all of them to make their way back in some form or other, at some point.

questions.question: Are we going to see fun modes like Blitz has them in the future?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Yes. We’re definitely going to have some fun with the game modes. Can't give anything away yet, but we are cooking some stuff for later in the year.

questions.question: [this question was a part of a bigger discussion in chat]...The developers could roll out a new game mode in less than 24h. They have a team of at least 200 ppl .... I could probably do it myself in a week. They're just dragging it out for no reason. When you have a team of 200 people, the question isn't "Can we make a new mode?" The question is "Which mode should we make"

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: So, first of all you have to understand that if you have a team of 200, right? Not all of those people are technically able to make a game mode. Then we are also working on things already and while we can absolutely make a prototype of a game mode, very quickly, and we do; and we iterate it very quickly with those, that doesn't mean that you can make a production-ready "I can release it to the game" game mode in that time.

questions.question: [From the same guy, replying to the comment in the chat] ...Players have been conditioned to accept waiting for vague, undefined updates in almost every game. People now treat long delays as normal, even when many features or game modes could realistically be developed much faster. That's why expectations are so low. Instead of asking "why something takes so long", people just accept it. Meanwhile, the quality of communication, the developers' responsiveness to the community, and the number of logical decisions seem to k...[?... he did not continue his complaint]

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text:
Game development is not easy. Making a game, especially an online multi-player game is non-trivial exercise. It's quite hard work. And we really want to make sure that the incidents like when we launched don't happen. 

We want [the game] to be stable, we want [the game] to be good quality. And doing all of that, getting all the little bits and bobs into something that makes like a full game mode, not just a prototype that kinda works and looks junky; but like a mode that works well, has UI, UX, sound support, the rewards work, the balancing works, all of that takes time. And we're working on it, and we're going to do as much as we can as quickly as we can, but it just takes time. And there is a lot of this...

Like if you have one cook making a soup, it'll take a certain amount of time and maybe if you have two cooks making soup, it'll go a bit quicker. But if I have 10 cooks making soup - probably won't make any difference, and they'll get in each other's way. And it holds true when it comes to game development as well. You can't have 200 ppl all working on 1 game mode, because it'll be an absolute mess. So, we do our best to communicate with you guys, right? We do this stream every week, I try to make sure that we are very open.

questions.question: Nerf the mines on Marder

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: They will be nerfed. Probably the damage, but stick around, they will be nerfed.

questions.question: Will there be any Balance adjustments? Some of the tanks are too powerful these days.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Yes there would be. Probably not with S1, but later in July, I want to say.

questions.question: Do you have any idea if current tanks will get more modules in the future?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Yes, I do have an idea. And probably yes, [they will get them]. But, in the future, not any time soon. They'll come a tiny bit later.

questions.question: Nerf fire ASAP

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Status effects will also be looked into, but a tiny bit later.

questions.question: The M1E1 (Abrams) lost its dozer blades from alpha. Is it a design choice or can it get them back at some point?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: I believe the M1E1 lost the dozers, and they got moved to Ember vehicle. So to XM1V.

questions.question: Is Ember getting a second tank by any chance?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Yes she will get her second tank. But not this season.

questions.question: My GPU crashes while a battle is in progress.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It would really help us if you could either contact our global support or through Discord and you can also attach a crash log and that will help us actually find the root cause - what's causing the crashes and then hopefully help solving it.

questions.question: Now with the BP lasting 2 months, do we expect any form of smaller form-factor content updates along the season?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It depends on what you mean by content, for example we did have our video where our director, where he discussed some of the QoL improvements we want to bring and that will come, at least it is planned for; mid-July. So there will be smaller patches inside of seasons, where it is deemed necessary, such as balance patches as well. So yes, smaller updates inside the seasons are quite possible.

questions.question: Any idea when Report [feature] will be added? I've had multiple players today [going afk]?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Passed onto the team. We know it's not a fun experience when players go afk, and we hope to improve on that soon.

questions.question: Is there any chance for a MoE system being available for HEAT?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Is there a chance? I would say - yes. However, no date when that might be. I've seen this request a couple of times, and I've passed it on every time.

questions.question: Will there be a video or article about the development process of HEAT in the future? It would be interesting to hear about the development of the game now and the reasons for changes during Alpha testing, when ideas were rejected, changed or added.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Yes, I mean that is an extremely broad topic. We'll have to see if and when we can do that. Personally, I don't think it would be very productive to talk about much from alpha, cuz alpha is by its nature is very early [in development], and the whole reason for alpha is to test hypotheses and see what works and what doesn't, and you need to have the freedom to do this, but we can have a conversation about what we did and why we did it, maybe. It's just that for a lot of the audience, it won't mean anything, because they weren't in alpha.

episode-2_09072026.txt.tldr: Balance changes and bugfixes incoming, possible future content talk, merch, state of the game addressed, lots of talk about road map (not going to come any time soon).

questions.question: What's the activation distance on the Marder’s mines?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: We are aware that whatever the activation distance is - it is probably too far right now. And in general we’re also aware that the mines are a little bit painful to deal with and that’s something that we absolutely want to improve. But unfortunately it’s taking a little bit of time because there are some non-trivial code changes that we have to make that happen and so you're going to have to bear with us a little bit. But we are working on it.

answers.speaker: Remmy, from the chat
answers.text: targeting range for the Marder mines was 45, it will get nerfed. The cone interior angle will also be adjusted

questions.question: When are we going to get some Competitive part of the game, like rating or something? When will the "Cutted" modules(of progression) of the tanks be unlocked? When will the "Factions" or any other missions that are going to give game resources as tech or credits?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: There are obviously a few things, many things that we are still working on at the moment. There are things that have been available in testing that are not in [the game] yet. There are things that were never available and are coming. But I can’t give you a precise answer for when these things are coming. They are going to come when they are ready. And it takes a little bit of time. And with the modules - they’ll be added slowly. We’d rather wait a little bit to make sure they’re properly balanced rather than adding them too quickly.

questions.question: Is it for me that the Flair agent always shows green dot and never goes away?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: known issue, will be fixed soon

questions.question: Can we get any news on the progress of ranked? Possible for season 2?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Possible, but unlikely right now. We’ll have to see.

questions.question: We need Merch and worldwide shipping please, cup, shirts, notepads please

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Having dealt with some merch topics extensively in the past I can tell you that it’s incredibly difficult and painful do to … But I know that the question about “Hey I would love to buy some merch” comes up quite frequently. I’ll see what I can do towards the later part of the year, maybe for the end of the year; what we can maybe conceivably set up.

questions.question: But World of Warships did sell merch

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Yes, it did. And I think it still does in some cases. And having dealt with some of it - it was painful to do. With sending merch and shipping world-wide, you have to then deal with people’s refunds, you have to have a way for them to contact you if issues go wrong. There are so many little aspects that play into this that you have to absolutely take into account if you want to do merch and not break the law.

questions.question: Is the fix of the Abrams legendary module included in "Life Easier Update" or are we going to wait till the Season 2 with legendary that isn't working?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: hatt5 module fix is planned to be applied with the next patch

questions.question: can we make Hound's ult be controllable while Hound is alive? and fly straight if Hound died? It would not waste at least ult

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: I've seen it requested, not sure, perhaps as a special tier 5 agent skill (random thought). I will pass it on

questions.question: Will there be a tournament this season?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: I would try, but I’m not sure if it’s going to be this season or maybe the beginning of the next season.

questions.question: Why “gunmetal haze” (black) camo is in the game but not available? Is there some special requirements to get it? If so then which ones?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It will be available later

questions.question: Why do you add all the micro fixes into one big patch, why not a patch fix every week?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: I think a lot of that has to do with the development process overall and how easy or hard it is to deploy an individual update.

questions.question: The most important question, why did we get the "game release" with 20% of content of gaming tests and alphas if the content and gaming code was already ready? What was the event that led to this decision?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Just because you saw it in an alpha test, doesn’t mean that it was ready-ready. In many cases [things that] we were testing were still in prototype stage, with mechanics, balance, effects that we weren't happy with, and so we made a decision to launch with what we launched with, and then add the rest as we go along.

questions.question: Btw there was already the "Friends" system that we didn't get at release. And there is also the account stat that we lose.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Yes, I’m aware, and you can expect these things to come back when they are ready.

questions.question: Do you realize that for most players with over 100 hours in the game, content is already running low, and grinding the same quick battle gets tedious? I’m a player with 350 hours under my belt, and I find it hard to keep playing the same mode

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Yes, and I absolutely agree that this is an issue. We need to give you stuff to do, things to unlock, things to achieve, things to grind for, but it is an unfortunate reality that we can’t magic these out of thin air, and you are going to have to give us time to implement them. That’s also why we are trying to do some little weekend events, something with some leader boards, to give you something that's different to play for.

questions.question: When will custom matches return? They said they're still being worked on, but when should we expect them?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: It’s very difficult for me to answer “when” questions, unless the “when” is really very soon, and we have it confirmed, cuz until I have that confirmation - if I give you an answer - I may not be able to stick to what I’m telling you. And I really dislike having to come afterward and say “I’m very sorry that we’re delayed [the update/feature/etc.]”. That’s why you're going to have to wait for us to be ready.

questions.question: MrConway, Can you give us some insight on the cycle for shop rotation items such as Camos and 3D Styles. The shop rotated a tad today but there were only a few items and the current seems to switch out every 2 weeks.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Yes, you can expect, on a general basis; by-weekly rotation depending on how much [we charge] for some items (I’m assuming gold-items will get longer windows to be purchased, while credit-items will be switched faster). But of course in the future, we may do some things a little bit differently. But generally we’re trying to make some changes [in the shop] every week.

questions.question: Are you aware that the game crashes on Xbox or not?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: I am not aware of any widespread crash issues on Xbox anymore. If you are still experiencing crashes please do reach out to our customer support, you can do that on Discord or on the portal, and we’ll do our best to help you. But we are working on some tech improvements across the board.

questions.question: When could we expect something like a roadmap?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Difficult question. But it’s one that I will raise once again and have a discussion about. I can’t promise we can give you one.

questions.question: What period of tank development does the game cover? Just the Cold War? Will it feature tanks like those in the console version, such as the Leopard 2A4 or 2A5? I think many players would like to see something like that

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: At the moment we have mostly around the Cold War. We are not super-super rigid about the exact time that we can have and that we can’t have. There is some flexibility, because we, as you know; gone a little bit loose with the historical accuracy in HEAT. So we may, at some point; have some newer tanks and some older tanks even, just wait and see.

questions.question: Why can't we team up with 5 friends instead of 3?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Matchmaking and balance aspect of that. If you are with 4 other friends, then the enemy team needs to also have 4 other friends. But I think this would be something cool to add.

questions.question: I think many players are waiting for training lobbies, so they can create their own tournaments and host more interesting matches than the randomizer offers; adding this mode would also temporarily fill the gap left by the absence of rankings and statistics in the game.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: I agree. I think it would be cool. I'm not sure when we will be able to do it, but I promise that I will have the conversation [with the team].

questions.question: Will you add another "class" of tanks, besides marksman, defender, attacker?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: In the long run, we may, but not any time soon. We have a couple more defenders, marksman and assault agents coming.

answers.speaker: Mr.Matcha
answers.text: Well I think we want to polish the existing formula, and then we can start trying things out, I assume.

questions.question: I really enjoy playing the new LEO 2KST, but got a little bit disappointed with its gun modules: purple (canister) and legendary (ap) are feeling much worse than the stock one (heat). Are those modules supposed to be like that or is it some kind of bug/mistake?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Canister is a whole different type of playstyle compared to the stock gun, so the canister one is intended to be like this. AP one is getting tidied up a bit , but no big changes. Stock HEAT will get adjusted also

questions.question: Will we see PVE story missions? a bit like the tutorial maybe?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: In the long run - we may do something like this, but at the moment we still have too much work to do regarding our core game to be able to focus on something like this. While this kind of thing (PvE missions) are very-very cool, they often don’t have a lot of replay ability

questions.question: Any tanks who wot heat can create Merkava, Leo2A7, T14 Armata, T90 ms, and artys (PzH2000, Paladin)?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: I hope we don’t do any artys, I’m not a big fan of arty, but some of those others - maybe possible. Some of them may be too modern for what we have in the game right now. But you can expect many more cool tanks to come.

questions.question: Will we see more "ways" to farm tech resources like special in-game missions except weekend Chases in future?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Absolutely! There [will] be more ways to earn plenty of different things, but it will come.

questions.question: How soon will we see custom lobbies in the game, like in Steel Hunters? Or is that not in the plans?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: They technically exist, they’re not in a great spot right now, like we would love them to be better. But we will have a discussion about enabling them because I would also love to be able to run some tournaments with you.

questions.question: Two more questions: Is there going to be a Ukrainian agent opposing to Raketa? Like T-84 Oplot and modern BTR with some FPV drone ability? What about rating game mode like in CS:GO or any additional game modes?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Not sure about the agent. On the 2nd point, if you mean ranked mode, then yes, it is something we would like to add tiny bit later

questions.question: Active players are eager to see the Road Map, so they can understand what the future holds for the game. Many players have already completed all the content currently available in the game, and the lack of information about what’s to come raises concerns that the project will simply lose its audience before the release of Season 2. The game already has few active players, and new ones aren’t joining due to the lack of any promotion for the game’s release.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: I am aware, and I’ll see what we can do. But giving out a road map means that we need to be sure about what we are doing and right now we’re still quite early in our journey, and we’re trying to be quite agile, right? As you can see with the mid-season patch, which is coming very soon; we’re doing our best to kind of squeeze in what we can do that you guys want us to do, when we can.

questions.question: When Leo 2FK enables jamming, intentionally miss and point to tank mid-flight (the guy talks about the way to counter Leo 2FK ability)

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Technically should not be possible

questions.question: Why did the developers buff the stats of tanks that were already easy to play—like the ALVT, Marder, and FV 62AB—as if deliberately boosting the most overpowered ones? Meanwhile, vehicles like the M55A1, M1A1, or M60A1—which are sluggish for their class and difficult to use effectively—get no such buffs. While all these tanks are decent enough in quick matches, if you introduce a ranked system, only 5 or 6 of them will actually see play because the rest simply aren't competitive.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Generally, our goal is to have all tanks be competitive and be balanced … Our intention was always to balance things. Sometimes things go a little bit too far, and I know that especially ALVT and Marder are in a very strong spot right now because of some of the abilities, quirks and how they work. This is something that we will absolutely address. We are working on an update for this, and we will keep you informed as to when we can deploy it. We’re doing our best to do this as quickly as possible.

episode-3_21072026.txt.tldr: Roadmap progress, future seasons potentially be longer than 2 months, Xbox crashes known, PIP for ult cinematics being considered but not going to be added any time soon due-to engine’s current technical limitations, QoL features in the backlog, other smaller stuff.

questions.question: Will this be the last patch of this season or should we expect more? I'm just curious

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: It is too early to talk about what’s going to be in there, but I am happy to report that we are planning to have an update 1.1.2 in a couple of weeks, where we’re going to do some more interesting stuff, but I don’t want to give everything away before it’s confirmed, so just look out for that when it comes. But yes, there will be another update. And It also brings me to another point - please do keep the feedback coming. I really hope that we’ve shown with this QoL focused update, that we take your feedback seriously, that we’re absolutely willing to revisit our own assumptions about what’s good and bad for the game, what needs to be changed, and make changes to it, even if it can be a little bit painful. For example with the ultimate abilities - we’ve spent a lot of time making those look really cool, and for now we're going to give some of you an option to switch them off. I think Esmatty pointed out [that] in future it would be cool to have like a Picture In Picture (PIP) solution, and maybe this is the approach that we will investigate. We’ll have to see, but for now, thank you very much for talking to us so much and please keep doing it so that we know what to fix next. Because for me, that’s an important question.

questions.question: Remmy, can we have a Q&A with the person responsible for movement physics? When I press Harpoon on my 287, randomness happens... Can I have someone to explain this randomness to me like I'm 5?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Yes, we can absolutely do a Q&A. It should not be a problem. At all. I don’t know if we'll be able to do it live, but I can collect questions. The [obj] 287 being one of them.

questions.question: Can you reduce the huge messages every time the Agent abilities are unlocked in a match. It's in the middle of the sight and too big and too often

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It’s in our backlog. And if not - I definitely complained about it, a little bit.

questions.question: Can we have something like an interactive explanation for everything that stands in the tank statistics in game? There are some parts I don't understand.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: This is one of the QoL features in our backlog … But you can also check our web article about what each of the stats mean.

questions.question: Still crashing on Xbox. Anything in the new patch that will help?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It’s been reported, it’s a…. I don’t want to say “isolated case” but it’s near “isolated case”, but it’s been reported. It is known. Thank you for reporting it in a lot of detail, which helped a lot.

questions.question: Are you working on PiP instead of totally removing the cinematics?

answers.speaker: Mr. Conway
answers.text: As I was mentioning earlier, PIP is something that we are considering, but there is also a technical hurdle there to make the engine support this. So, we’ll have to see.

questions.question: Why can’t we get patch fixes each week?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: This is because it takes us quite a bit of work to deploy a patch, and it also takes us quite a bit of time to get everything ready for said patch. So deploying something new, every single week, would be inefficient.

questions.question: Considering shortening the future seasons? Or adding more tanks in a single season

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: So, the main issue that we have with doing shorter seasons or adding more tanks every season - is that is takes us quite a long time to make the content for the season, and there is a hard limit on how much [content] we can realistically make in a given time frame. So, while there definitely is a chance that you will be seeing more tanks in a single season, we probably will actually have slightly longer seasons than now, BUT, as you saw with [update] 1.1.1 - we do also add stuff in-between [of season]. So, just because there is a season [active] - doesn’t mean that you won't get any new content within that season.

questions.question: Did we talk about getting a roadmap at least for the remainder of 2026? Our player count is not great. We need more people coming in. Communication and Content. Appreciate your hard work.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: We did talk about it, and I have started talking about it internally, but I can’t promise when we can do a roadmap. But we would like to! I just want to make sure that we can stick to what’s in the roadmap, and we are still making a couple of decisions as to what some of that roadmap will be.

questions.question: Guys, we love the game. That’s why we’re here. Not being able to share an internal roadmap, you must have one, folks will continue to leave and it hurts. I am asking because I care and want full teams and not bots and the game to grow.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: We of course have an internal roadmap, absolutely, but the tricky part is turning the internal roadmap into an external roadmap. BUT! That is not to say that we are not having conversations about this and that we are not sharing other things. But I will try.

episode-4_23072026.txt.tldr: Balancing discussion, chat being worked on, QoL features, longshot xd being worked on.

questions.question: Why was 2FK improved, but not 2KST improved? 2FK was good, so why touch it and turn it into an imba?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: The changes we’ve done were to HEAT guided and non-guided ATGMs, so technically the same adjustments that 2FK got [were applied to other vehicles that use HEAT]

questions.question: Are you going to fix 2KST's hull traverse, boost and AP rounds, which are obviously bugged?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: For a boost - it might be a bug, I know what you mean exactly. The other ones are not “bugs” so to say. AP module will get adjusted. Hull traverse - maybe. We’ll see. But it does turn a little bit like a cruise ship.

questions.question: When is the new content planned at least approximately? There is nothing to do in the game, everything is upgraded and bypassed, the combat pass was completed in 10 minutes after the update, and the 2KST and 2FK tanks were upgraded in a few days, the game became boring.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It will come. Soon. More patches and season updates are coming.

answers.speaker: Mr.Matcha
answers.text: Yeah, these things take time. We physically cannot produce so much content. It takes time, especially when we have multiple platforms as well.

questions.question: Will new modules be added to existing tanks?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Yes, in the future.

questions.question: Will there be custom lobbies and statistics in the second season?

answers.speaker: Mr.Matcha
answers.text: I don’t think in the second season at least. But, in the near future we definitely want to have something competitive for you guys.

questions.question: When there will be an in-game chat?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Soon, we hope.

questions.question: Longshot XP fix when?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: We know it. It’s being worked on.

questions.question: Will the game feature modern post-Cold War vehicles, similar to how they are implemented in the console version of WoT? I’d love to see vehicles like the T-80, Leopard 2A5, and M1A2, all of which are present in the console version;?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: I don’t know, the current roster of the vehicles we have is not final. More will come. What those tanks will look like is still yet to be decided. But we have a lot of tanks in mind that we want to add. So, stay tuned. More will come.

questions.question: So, not fixing the descriptions and not letting us know what each gun/module is doing?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: I know some bugs where the descriptions are either wrong or not totally accurate. It will be fixed.

questions.question: When will you introduce a premium tank which earns more of everything?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Never.

questions.question: Any planned ranked mode coming?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Yes. It’s being worked on. When [it’s going to be released] - we cannot say yet. Not because we don’t want to but because we want to make sure that if we do give everyone a date - we can make sure we deliver.

questions.question: I've been having fun and the new tanks are very fun to fight against. It is interesting about the frontal armor of the new leo (2KST), I didn't expect it to be so strong.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: 2KST has some frontal armor that's a bit annoying to deal with depending on who you are, but that will be adjusted.

questions.question: Are you guys going to change the squad a bit? It’s kinda confusing to add people or at least an in game fried list?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It’s being worked on.

questions.question: We really need battle replays; will this be introduced soon?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: I don’t know if soon, but definitely yes.

questions.question: QoL question: The 'last' zoom level on pressing the zoom button kinda bugs me every time. Any plans of introducing a default zoom level and lock the zoom mode only on press instead of scroll?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: I know what you mean, I will pass it on.

questions.question: Why do you guys think ALVT needs a nerf?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It has crazy damage output and reloads. But it will very, very, very, likely lose the Zealous from the modules.

episode-5_11082026.txt.tldr: Console issues fixes are coming, balance changes are coming, Season 2 will have a new map, lore being not a priority right now, communication and social features are a priority right now, vehicle missions getting rebalanced soon, low player count addressed, info on replays, other smaller stuff.

questions.question: Please fix sheridan turn ability

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Being looked into.

questions.question: Is the dev team working on fixing any issues regarding game crashes? I know update 1.1 was more taxing, but I am crashing every other game on PC even after reducing FPS and graphics.

answers.speaker: Moonlight
answers.text: Yes, we are working on it. It’s just to say that - crashes and stability optimization of a game are things that take some time, but please believe that we are working out best to actually try to fix this. We might not have [a fix] for a specific issue [yet], but we are certainly working on it and our team is really working hard to optimize and civilize the game.

questions.question: On console when you want to turn it takes ages

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: I think this is a known issue and should be fixed with one of the following patches.

notes: fixed in patch that comes out on 12th of August

questions.question: Any insight on how to unlock the Discord Skins?

answers.speaker: Moonlight
answers.text: Sometimes we have missions on Discord (Discord Quest: play 15 min of WoT HEAT and get the skin) and those missions will unlock those Discord skins. I don’t think we have one running right now, but stay tuned, they will be along very soon.

questions.question: Are there more maps coming soon?

answers.speaker: Moonlight
answers.text: Yes, there will be new maps coming soon.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Yes, season 2 will have a new map

notes: the map is confirmed to be Inferno.

questions.question: Will there be interactions between agents at the start of the game like in overwatch where they talk about their lore?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Not sure that this is something that’s planned today. In general, we’ve been taking a very light touch to communicating our lore. It’s mostly been hinted at in some materials and the update videos, here and there. This is something that we want to expand upon more in the future, but among the things that we’re doing, I would put this as a lower priority. First we have a bigger fish to fry.

questions.question: sooo... 1.1.2 are the long-awaited bugfixes, and the next-week lodestar is more like the next content bundle?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: So there is a mix of things going on here. So, in 1.1.2 we are going to be activating a gamemode, which some of you may remember from previous test iterations back in alpha; and then yes, there are some QoL changes coming along with it, as usual, because we’re really trying to make improvements. And - always bugfixes. Are we fixing every bug? Probably not. But we try and fix as many as we can.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: There is a long-ish list coming in this next patch, and even longer in going in a patch after that (season patch). I know because I’ve written every single one of those, so…

questions.question: I posted info to discord info about agent Embers intel mission problem for minefield damage not registered last week, did anyone from dev team have looked into it?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Yes. I logged a lot of bugs with the missions. Granted a lot of them were with the Leo 2FK, but I will check on the one you sent. Luckily I’ve been getting better at spotting these [bugs] internally, so-to-say. But we’re fixing a lot of the missions and actually for one of the following patches, we’ll bring a huge rebalance for most of them (missions). There will be a very-very long list of them.

questions.question: Have you guys read the feedback regarding a BP store for surplus intel etc.? To use the intel you collect but have nothing to use on.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Yes. I think this is something that we are aware of ourselves as well. We need to find something, right? The main problem is - if we have a store for you to spend surplus intel on - we need to put something in the store for you to spend it on. And making these things, that you want to buy; this is the challenge to at least to this in a short term. But, and I know this is not going to be applicable for you; for people who joined the game later on, we will also be giving them an opportunity to use their surplus intel to complete past battle passes. Not one from Season 0, but other ones. Again, more on that, Soon™

questions.question: Can we address the elephant in the room pls? Player count is so low that sometimes half the team are Bots. Any roadmap or plans you have going forward. I’m only asking because I care about the game. Thx.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Obviously player counts would be great to have higher, but we are very aware of the fact that we have quite a bit of work to do. Changes that you guys have requested, QoL things that we needed to ship, we’re also approaching the end of Season 1, so a lot of people have finished the content. Then there is an unconscionable heat wave ripping through the majority of where our player base is situated, and so all of these things kinda of play together. At the moment we have a little bit low numbers, but that’s absolutely fine, and we fully anticipate that this is going to change. Don’t worry.

questions.question: Will the next battle pass be the same or bigger?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: I believe it will be slightly bigger.

notes: not slightly. 3 months instead of 2. Confirmed Dev Talk #2 video

questions.question: Are there still 200 people working on the game?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Absolutely, although there are a lot of people on vacations at the moment, given the fact that it’s summer.

notes: and they're still hiring ppl for HEAT.

questions.question: Profile menu come with this patch?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Not a profile menu yet, but something else profile menu adjacent, maybe?

notes: leader board and increase in account levels from max 11, to 100? At least that's what been shared on discord

questions.question: Will ALVT be nerfed? Or does it look balanced for devs?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: We nerfed it a bit last patch. And there is a further nerf to his modules coming, maybe even next patch, there might be a nerf. We’re getting rid of the Zealous from the ALVT, but again, don’t quote me on it being the next patch or the patch after. Pretty sure it's the next one, but it will lose Zealous from the modules. No more Zealous.

questions.question: Why can't we invite a player to a platoon directly from the post-battle results screen? Why do we have to exit the garage, open the battle results again, and only then send a platoon invitation?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: It’s because it does not design optimally and in fact, this is a true story; we are going to be talking to our development team about exactly this specific feature tomorrow, because it needs to be better.

questions.question: Why can you not see who is in a division on the scoreboard in-game?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: We actually had that feature a while back. I don’t know if we plan to bring it back. Maybe it will come.

questions.question: Social features and communications implementation should be a priority at the moment.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: Yes, they are a priority. It takes a little bit of time to do this. It’s not something that you can just toggle and suddenly its there, especially cross-platform, it’s a little bit of work.

questions.question: It doesn't show the tank in the post battle screen but just what agent people were playing? Is that a new thing?

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway & Remmy
answers.text: [they go on a bit of a discussion, that basically boils down to - it’s not a bug but a feature, that is made in preparation for another feature which will come into the game very soon]

questions.question: Are there plans for new game modes besides kill confirmed and capture the flag. like tam death match

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Yes, there are plans for more gamemodes. Perhaps not what you expected.

notes: Plant and Defuse for a limited time as testing

questions.question: Why are replays still not available in the game? Are there any plans to add this feature?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Yes. There are. We had this conversation not long ago with some developers.

questions.question: Why doesn't the HSTV-L earn spotting XP when enemies detected by its probes are damaged by allies? Since its probes are designed to spot enemies, shouldn't the vehicle receive additional XP for assisted spotting damage?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It’s either 0 right now, and we’re planning on moving it to like, 1 or 2, or it is already 1 or 2. But it’s a part of a bigger system we’re trying out right now, so changes will come.

questions.question: Has there been discussions on being able to change servers/regions. I.E. being in NA to EU. It would be nice to play with/against friends.

answers.speaker: Mr.Conway
answers.text: We don’t actually have regions. We actually only have 1 server, and you already play with all of your friends from other regions, and you can test it by squadding up with anyone. No matter where they are from. And it just works. And cross-platform.

questions.question: Will you fix the armor layout for the console in the next patch?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Yes. It’s fixed.

notes: I can't find mention of it in the patch notes, so I'm assuming he meant that it's fixed for Season 2 patch??

questions.question: Will the tank's characteristics be updated to reflect the installed modules? There should be a visual way to see how each module affects the vehicle's performance and statistics.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text:
Great question. It was a feature we had in Alpha 1 and I assume that’s why you are pointing it out. For now - no. Because it is a bit too resource demanding. It’s actually a lot more than just a little bit. It would be something really, really, really cool, we would maybe like to do in the future, but at the moment, we don’t have plans for that. But I agree it would be very cool. 

Also during stream, Matcha talked about two things: 
First is a potential community contest in creating tanks - you create an agent, give him two tanks, and come up with the abilities for them (and for the agent as well) to win a certain prize. Which one - wasn't specified, and whether the tank end up in game at some point - also wasn't specified.
Second - he wants to get one of the actual developers on stream, to answer some of the questions. However, it is a matter of their will in the first place, as some people might be talkative in chat or elsewhere, but be quite shy on camera specifically. 

Dan[etoDanya] talked about one of the ways replays will be implemented in the game: it will save your last 10 matches, and by a working principle will be similar to CS replays, where you be as an observer in the replay. He also talked about the problem where after 10-15 games, the FPS in the game starts to drop. He mentioned that it is an engine problem, and that devs are aware and working on it.

episode-6_13082026.txt.tldr: AFK problem addressed, more console fixes are coming, modding support is in talks but nothing decisive yet, Saturday tournament stream announcement, Sheridan and T62 rebalancing are in works.

questions.question: Why is it by date? Why is it always unavailable? (about plant/defuse)

answers.speaker: Mr.Matcha
answers.text: We see it as a “testing purpose”. We count on your feedback, what works, what doesn’t, so we can adjust, fix things before we can fully launch it.

questions.question: Will Leo 2ST receive hiding from Thermo Vision on invis?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: I don’t know. I’ve asked, but I don't think I received an answer.

questions.question: Are optimizations coming to PC? [Intel Core] i7 is struggling with this game.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It might be a bug, it might be an actual issue. What would help us - if you could reach out to our support team. They might ask for exact details. They might also be able to provide you with an answer as to - yes it’s a problem with the game, or maybe it's a problem with the device, which I doubt.

questions.question: A few points that have been raised by viewers: The ability to switch between NA/EU/ASIA server hosts as game ping varies according to who is hosting in a squad. Account botting perhaps to farm tech points seems to be a new issue we have noticed in games (due to tanks being in game, but not moving nor disconnected or AFK)

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: The first question - I’m not sure of. The second one - we’re aware of this and also not aware of this. We’re aware that AFK is a problem right now, and we’re working on some issues, and then if someone is AFK, they’re becoming a free score for the enemy, so that’s something we’re working on. I actually discussed it recently with the man himself - Warpurple

questions.question: Why doesn’t the Friends window show whether a friend has accepted the squad invite?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Is it on the Xbox you’re referring to? And if so - we are aware of that issue. It’s been an issue for a while, though I kinda remember it being fixed, but apparently maybe not. I’ve seen it from another player in Discord. So I’m not sure if it’s the same Xbox issue.

questions.question: Given the current online player count, have you considered reducing the number of 10v10 battles? Quite often, during early mornings or late at night, matches end up being 7v7 to 9v9 with real players, and the remaining slots are filled with bots, which makes the gameplay frustrating.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Of course our prime times, for example in Europe. At certain times during the evening you might see a lower drop, because people are sleeping, so you may encounter some bots there. Of course, it’s not always going to be this way, we’re aware of this, we’re working on it, but it can happen.

questions.question: Matchmaker needs a rework as well, for example in my current match, enemy team has XM1V, and we don't have this imbalance in certain game modes such as hardpoint or conquest

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Matchmaker is something we’re paying very close attention to, and hopefully we will improve on.

questions.question: The issue comes with XM1V laying mines on a cap circle and other team not having a tank capable of clearing the mines, this why you get imbalance

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: That’s something actually we’re trying to adjust a little bit through other vehicles (engineering?) I will not say more to it, because it’s another test we’re doing right now with a certain vehicle that Rickles is working on. Rickles being one of our designers. Nothing final, but it might be something that will be adjusted slightly.

notes: Rickles confirmed earlier that he is working on an M1150 ABV engineering vehicle that will be Ember’s second tank. He also shared that it is his last vehicle he's going to work on, as he is working on core game systems, and he simply doesn’t have enough time to do vehicles as well

questions.question: Are you going to be doing cinematics for new tanks now that they are turned off by default?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: I don’t know. I don’t think we have any plans at the moment, at least that I know of. It would be cool, in the future to continue this, because the cinematics are awesome, but maybe in the future.

questions.question: Remmy is cheesing the 2fk aim ability (in regard to by-passing the 2FK’s ability by not looking directly at him)

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It’s a known thing that you can move your reticle away from the 2FK and then move it back, and you’ll hit it, and you're not going to be affected by the jammers. Kinda intended also not intended at the same time. Until that gets fixed, and I dare to say maybe it’ll get fixed but there is no decisive decision on that at the moment, so it seems like a good thing to counter the vehicle at the moment.

questions.question: What about the armor layout on the console? When will it be fixed?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Soon. I’ve already added it to a certain patch notes.

questions.question: Don't see why it should be fixed (in regard to 2FK’s ability). Maybe make the window smaller before the bloom, but it's a fair counterplay tbf.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: Because it’s a direct counter to the ability, and it was not originally intended. Right now it’s a workaround but not quite.

questions.question: Did you buff the movement of the FV?

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: We’re testing a couple of things, I don’t think there are any movement [adjustments] planned. There are other extra functionalities that we’re playing around with, but I don't think movement is one of them.

questions.question: What's up with the introduced bug with the base cap icon color? Like you decap a base, and it's showing your team blue color lowering with the enemy red color as the background. Irritating.

answers.speaker: Remmy
answers.text: It’s known. Actually one of our UI designers reported it. It’s known and it will be fixed.

questions.question: Any plans on supporting and giving more access to information that game carries for the modding community - both the stats and for example UI restyles?

answers.speaker: Mr.Matcha
answers.text:
If I’m not mistaken there is this discussion going on right now, there is nothing set in stone, but I think the idea has been thrown by the community team if I’m correct. I remember our colleague - Lynx was trying to get something out of it, so I know that there is something going on, but nothing is set in stone.

Remmy also shares that he knows people are hating on Raketa in KC. He says that “We are already looking into T62, and we’ve actually play tested some changes we want to make, internally. Nothing final, of course, but I dare to say - we are on the right track with getting Raketa back in line”. Later he also yapped for solid 2 or so minutes about M60A2 and Sheridan, specifying that the ladder will get buffed, and the main thing they are looking at (at his moment) is mobility, to make him “more nimble” and bring him overall in-line with HSTV-L. A bit later he also adds that they are also testing a few other changes to Sheridan, to see what will work well, and hull traverse is one of the changes they are testing. He specifies that doesn’t mean that sheridan will get a hull traverse speed, rather that the devs are aware of it, and are working on Sheridan to see how they play out.

Matcha also made an announcement that, this Saturday (15/08/2026) at 14:00 UTC (approx), they will have a showcase tournament in plant and defuse. Unfortunately, this time at least, the tournament itself is exclusive to LSP players, while others will be able to see it through stream, where all 3 CMs (Remmy, MrMatcha and MrConway) will be commentating on it.
